data_description.port: Port which should be opened to receive the payloads
data_description.delimiter: Which character separates the information (ignored for rare)
data_description.type: Protocol depends on ekey controller: home, multi or rare
data_description.rare_auth_cmd: Command value that means a successful authentication (rare protocol only, default 1)
data_description.rare_fail_cmd: Command value that means a failed authentication (rare protocol only, default 19)
